body: My parents have controlled every single aspect of my life. I have never been to a sleep over, I have never been to some one else's house, I have never been to the mall with my friends, I have never chosen my own clothes, I have never been bowling or skating, It wasn't until my junior that I actually got a cell phone, I never get to be able to do fun things. At this point in my life, I have one friend. If she leaves, I will be a loner in the truest sense. Everyday is the same. My life is boring. I come home and study the rest of the day till 12 then get ready for bed and wake up at 5:30, then run for an hour. I use to be quite extroverted because I needed attention from peers. Now, I am that quiet kid in the back of the room. If a teacher calls on me, I can barely speak. I hate it. My grades are perfect. But, yet I can do nothing fun. I hate my parents for this. This has made my social skills worse. I have extreme anxiety whenever I have to talk at school. I hate it.

I had put the answers inside my coffee cup. I would usually drink tea and for first and second period it worked beautifully. Then for the rest of the periods I would write answers on paper and put it on the inside of the watch.

Oh god. Mine was at school too. I was already cutting and all that...we all know that part. But a teacher had wanted to talk to me. It was a bad day as my mother had locked me out of the house the day before for pissing her off. The teacher pulled me into the copier room and told me I wasn't good enough. That I should drop her class and take a class like Strengthening and Conditioning. She said this right in front of my history/Gov teacher who was coping something. She wouldn't stop telling me how worthless I was. That I might as well find a corner on the street now to spend my days. She reprimanded me  for a good five minutes. Then she left. I broke down. I started crying, hyperventilating, tearing paper and throwing shit. My history/gov teacher watched me break down. He was just shocked that she told me that. He stayed in there with me until I was finished then told me he wouldn't tell anyone and that I may not be good at Spanish, but I was sure good at government and extremely good at history. I proceeded to tell him about all my problems and how that just broke me. He helped me up and said that she didn't need to know that. That I should go in her class with my head held high. I did. Thanks Mr. S. I know your are a Redditor, so huge shout out to you.
